rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A TypeScript-based server that provides secure database connectivity for MySQL, Redis, and MongoDB through the Model Context Protocol. Features configurable security modes including read-only restrictions, connection pooling for MySQL, and comprehensive error handling across all three database types. Built with the official SDK and includes proper TypeScript configuration, GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows for both Node.js and Deno environments, and a clean modular architecture separating database connectors, configuration management, and security controls.
